title: The Cipher of Greywater Bay
author: Petra Brightwater
blurb: Marguerite Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
